verses.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
"On the first day of the first month, set up the holy tent, the Tent of Meeting.
Put the ark of the covenant in it, and hang the curtain in front of the ark to hide it.
Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
Put the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the covenant, and hang the screen at the entrance of the holy tent.
Put the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the holy tent, the Tent of Meeting.
Put the washing bowl between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
Set up the courtyard around it, and hang the screen at the entrance to the courtyard.
Take the anointing oil and anoint the holy tent and everything in it. Set it and all its furniture apart as holy, and it will be holy.
Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its tools. Set the altar apart as holy, and it will be most holy.
Anoint the washing bowl and its stand, and set them apart as holy.
Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
Dress Aaron in the holy clothes, anoint him, and set him apart as holy, so that he can serve me as priest.
Bring his sons and dress them in shirts.
Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they can serve me as priests. Their anointing will make them priests for all generations to come, forever."
Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
So the holy tent was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.
Moses set up the holy tent. He put its bases in place, set up its frames, put in its crossbars, and set up its posts.
Then he spread the tent over the holy tent and put the covering over the tent, as the LORD had commanded him.
He took the tablets of the covenant and put them inside the ark. He fixed the poles to the ark and put the cover on top of it.
Then he brought the ark into the holy tent and hung the curtain to hide the ark of the covenant, as the LORD had commanded him.
Moses put the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the holy tent, outside the curtain.
He set out the bread on it in front of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
He put the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting across from the table, on the south side of the holy tent.
He set up the lamps in front of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
Moses put the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the curtain,
and burned sweet-smelling incense on it, as the LORD had commanded him.
Then he hung the screen at the entrance of the holy tent.
He put the altar of burnt offering near the entrance of the holy tent, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the LORD had commanded him.
He put the washing bowl between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.
Moses, Aaron, and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.
Whenever they went into the Tent of Meeting or came near the altar, they washed, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Then Moses set up the courtyard around the holy tent and the altar, and hung the screen at the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the holy tent.
Moses could not go into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the holy tent.
In all their travels, whenever the cloud lifted from above the holy tent, the people of Israel would set out.
But if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out until the day it lifted.
So the cloud of the LORD was over the holy tent by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, where all the people of Israel could see it, in all their travels.
